response.rewrite: In adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus, treatment with OZEMPIC 0.5 mg or 1 mg as an adjunct to diet and exercise led to mean weight reductions of 3.5 kg and 6.0 kg, respectively, compared with 1.2 kg with placebo, over 30 weeks (difference from placebo: –2.2 kg [95% CI –3.4, –1.1] for 0.5 mg and –4.7 kg [95% CI –5.8, –3.6] for 1 mg).
